info.name: identity-access-service (MS-17) local
description: Functional tests of identity-access-service (MS-17) on localhost:8097.
4. Set the collection variable staffPassword to STAFF_LOCAL_PASSWORD of your .env (default local-staff-password).
Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or newman). The sign-in folders automate the authorization
code flow with PKCE, the form login with CSRF and the TOTP step: no browser is needed. Requests disable
Postman's cookie jar and redirect following; the session cookie travels in {{sessionCookie}}.
TOTP secrets of staff accounts are created on their first sign-in and kept in the collection variables
tellerTotpSecret and boardTotpSecret. Do not clear them: without them the account can only sign in again after
an authenticator reset or after 'docker compose --profile identity down -v'.

request.description: Requires a board token with function PRESIDENT or COMPLIANCE and amr=mfa. The teller's sessions are revoked and the next sign-in enrols a new TOTP secret.
Presenting a rotated refresh token is treated as theft: the whole session is revoked.

exec: pm.test("latest token is revoked too", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("invalid_grant"); });
